scope: Independent bounded Python DSP research components; no claim to match maintained FFmpeg resampler or checkpoint ABI

resample.algorithm: 17tap normalized windowed-sinc polyphase rational48k→44.1k and32k, absolute output indices, finitezero extension, same ordered accumulation
resample.correctness: Continuous output versus irregular independent job partition, full bytes and randomrange/empty/end boundaries; phase-reset and missinghalo controls must differ, job returns release local buffers
resample.performance: Same complete1s output continuous versus irregularjobs with same shared immutable filter bank; bank creation recorded as common cold cost. One warmup and5 alternating pairs; candidate median<=1.20 baseline, no parallel speed claim

iir.algorithm: Stable float64 directformIItransposed biquad, complete two-value state snapshots every1024input samples, key includes coefficients/source/precision/order/denormal policy
iir.correctness: 80 deterministic random64samplequeries exact against separately computed continuous recurrence; zero-state, changedkey, corruptedcheckpoint reject/differ; clear/close invalidates handle
iir.performance: 80query batch baseline replayfromzero eachquery versus buildcheckpoints once+resumeeachquery; all cold construction included. One warmup then5 alternating pairs; candidate median<=0.8baseline. Raw CPU wall/processedcounts/cachepayload only, no energy claim
